reference: Owner-approved parchment map concept from this conversation, 2026-10-11
integration: Transparent padding trimmed, proportional resize, anchored into 8x frames. No repainting or recolouring.

prompts.name: mountain-a
prompts.prompt: Create a SINGLE isolated game map glyph on a truly transparent RGBA background, inspired by the fine pen cartography in the reference. Hand drawn literary fantasy parchment map illustration. Dark warm sepia ink #2b1a0e, irregular organic pen outlines, delicate purposeful right-side hatching. The object interior has flat warm ivory #f0e3c3 opaque fill so it occludes shapes behind; outside object is transparent. No parchment rectangle, no cast shadow, no ground oval, no labels, no text, no UI. Simple readable silhouette when reduced to 40 pixels. Not photoreal, not vector clipart, not 3D game icon. Centered object fully in frame with generous transparent margin. One craggy broad mountain with one offset main peak, a smaller shoulder, three angular ridge folds; sparse hatching on its right slopes, open ivory left slopes. Width:height about 1.25. No foothill landscape. A map symbol, not a scenic painting.
